name: phoenix-zero
description: Pre-flight network health check for L2 chains using kernel-level eBPF telemetry. Returns PASS/DEGRADED/FAIL with RTT, packet-loss, and timestamp evidence. Covers 12 L2 networks. Premium data via x402 micropayment ($0.01).

tools.name: preflight_network_health
tools.description: Determine whether an L2 network is currently suitable for transaction execution using kernel-level network telemetry. Returns PASS, DEGRADED, or FAIL with RTT, packet-loss and timestamp evidence.
